name: Ryu
description: Powerful fighter with excellent range and attack rate! Chance to deliver a Savage Blow (Area Attack)

name: Chun-Li
description: Superior warrior with quick movement and rapid attacks! Attacks have a chance to Knockback Red, Black, and Aliens.

name: Guile
description: Solid defense, superior speed, plus Area Attacks! Extra tough vs Floating, with chance to Slow & Weaken enemies!

name: Zangief
description: Super-tough brawler delivering big damage! Has a chance to avoid damage from Zombie attacks. Omnistrikes have Zombie Killer ability included!

name: Balrog
description: Only attacks, Zombie, Red, and Black enemies, but is a cost-effective and well-balanced hero! Plus, Area Attacks stop Zombie enemies from Reviving!

name: Vega
description: Effective Long-distance Area attacker with speedy movement. 100% Freeze versus Metal enemies, with chance of Critical!

name: Sakura
description: A hero with tough defense and rapid Omnistrike attacks. Delivers massive damage to Traited enemies.

name: Cammy
description: Low-cost unit with rapid attacks. Deals Insane damage to Aliens with area attacks and may Dodge their attacks in turn.

name: Akuma
description: High-frequency long-range attacks! Insane area damage to Traitless enemies.

name: C. Honda
description: A rapid-fire Area attacker with might defense to boot! Extra tough versus Angel enemies.

name: Zangief Cat
description: Hero combining both powerful attacks and sturdy defense. Deals Massive damage to Floating with area attacks that have a chance to deal a Savage Blow.

name: Jamie Cat
description: Long-range attack specialist with sturdy defense. Strong against Aku. Immune to Surge damage, with attack power strengthened as they take damage.

name: Balrog Cat
description: Cost-effective hero with a long attack range! Strong versus Black enemies.

name: Vega Cat
description: Cost-effective hero with powerful attacks. Strong vs. Angel enemies, with immunity to Toxic!

name: Sagat Cat
description: Cost-effective hero with rapid-fire attacks! Strong vs. Floating, with immunity to Wave damage!

name: M. Bison Cat
description: A long-distance Area attack specialist hero! Tough vs. Aliens, with a small chance to break enemy Barriers.
